title: Flat Troll Blue Paper Towel Holder, 15.5-Inch Wall Mount Powder Coated Iron, Pipeline Collection, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Flat Troll Blue, wall mounted paper towel holder, 15.5 in long x 3 in high x 4 in projection, powder coated iron pipe-style design for kitchen paper towel storage and dispensing, which presents a distinctive, muted blue-gray tone that adds artistic character to contemporary kitchen designs. Industrial modern look inspired by pipe fittings; works with modern or traditional decor. Wall mount installation saves counter space and mounts firmly with color coordinating screws (#8 x 1 1/4) and included installation hardware. Protected using highly durable powder coat for a clean, decorative finish and corrosion-free, rust-free performance. Contemporary design with rustic influences. Limited lifetime warranty. Part of the Pipeline collection for matching pipeline, pipe-style accessories and loft-style fixtures — Allied Brass Pipeline.
